claims.text: The top-level schema requires schema const lineage.family/1, id and result, allows an optional correlation_id, and closes unknown keys.
The result section selects between an untrusted payload and a tool_error reference for the success and failure branches.
The untrusted anyOf enumerates the per-tool result shapes from reference and skill through agent, run, bench, ledger, openfresnel and capabilities results.

decision.rule: Change here when the family receipt envelope, tool result shapes or error mapping needs to change.
decision.failure: Valid tool results are rejected, unknown shapes are accepted, or correlation identifiers mismatch between request and receipt.

questions.q: Where is the family receipt envelope and correlation_id shape defined?
Where should I change the per-tool untrusted result shapes?
Where can I debug why a tool result fails family receipt validation?
